important_limit: Closure means the identified amendment and commencement chain is sufficient for the specific core proposition. It does not mean every provision of the 1964 Act has been audited.
remaining_gaps: Later effects unrelated to the core propositions remain outside this closure.
Case-law and final publication-source audit remain separate.
